scope: Reputation, Federation and Empire naval rank, Alliance standing, Pilots' Federation career ranks, system permits, rank-locked ships, and permit-gated engineer progression used by the Mongrels Field Manual and Ask the Mongrels.

entries.topic: Rank, Reputation, Influence & Permits Are Different Systems
entries.ruleOfThumb: Do not treat rank, reputation, influence and permits as one progress bar. Reputation is your standing with a faction, influence is that faction's BGS share in a system, naval rank is permanent personal progression, and permits are access rights earned through specific requirements.
details: Minor-faction reputation affects how that faction treats you and what missions it offers; it does not directly equal the faction's system influence.
Federation and Empire naval ranks are separate from superpower reputation and are permanent once earned.
Pilots' Federation career ranks are a separate progression family based on activities such as combat, trade, exploration, mercenary work, exobiology and CQC.
System permits can come from naval rank, career rank, or reputation/invitation requirements depending on the system.

entries.ruleOfThumb: Minor-faction reputation runs Hostile → Unfriendly → Neutral → Cordial → Friendly → Allied. Higher reputation generally unlocks better mission access and rewards from that faction.
details: Common positive thresholds are Cordial at 15%, Friendly at 35%, and Allied at 75%.
Completing missions, profitable activity at faction-controlled assets, bounty/combat-bond hand-ins and exploration-data sales can increase reputation when credited to that faction.
Failing missions, committing crimes against the faction or fighting against it can lower reputation.
Minor-faction reputation does not use the same decay rule as major-superpower reputation.

entries.ruleOfThumb: Superpower reputation is standing, not naval rank. It helps relationships with aligned factions and some engineer requirements, but it does not replace Federal or Imperial Navy promotion progression.
details: Superpower reputation and naval rank are explicitly separate values.
Major-superpower reputation above the Allied floor can decay downward over time toward the normal Allied threshold; naval rank does not decay.
Alliance reputation matters for some requirements even though the Alliance has no naval rank ladder.
When the goal is Navy progression, choose high-REP mission rewards from minor factions aligned with the desired superpower.

entries.ruleOfThumb: Run missions for Federation-aligned minor factions and favor REP rewards. When the naval-rank bar reaches 100%, complete a Federal Navy promotion mission to advance one rank.
details: The Federal Navy Auxiliary has 14 earned ranks from Recruit through Admiral.
Naval rank is permanent once earned.
Promotion missions are distinct Navy-labelled missions; ordinary Federation-aligned missions build the progression toward them.
Current community reports continue to confirm that additional aligned mission progress can bank beyond a displayed 100% rank bar while you wait for the promotion mission.

sources.name: E:D Black Box — Superpower Rank, updated 2026

entries.ruleOfThumb: The major Federal milestones are Midshipman for the Dropship, Petty Officer for Sol, Chief Petty Officer for the Assault Ship, Ensign for the Gunship, and Rear Admiral for the Corvette.

entries.ruleOfThumb: Run missions for Empire-aligned minor factions and favor REP rewards. At 100% naval progress, complete an Imperial Navy promotion mission to move up one rank.
details: The Imperial Navy Auxiliary has 14 earned ranks from Outsider through King.
Imperial rank is permanent and is independent of your current Empire reputation percentage.
You do not need to pledge to an Imperial Powerplay figure to earn Imperial Navy rank.
The most commonly targeted milestone is Duke for the Imperial Cutter.

sources.name: E:D Black Box — Superpower Rank, updated 2026

entries.ruleOfThumb: The major Imperial milestones are Master for the Courier, Squire for Achenar, Baron for the Clipper and Summerland, Earl for Facece, and Duke for the Cutter.

entries.topic: Alliance Has Reputation, Not a Navy Rank Ladder
entries.ruleOfThumb: There is no Alliance naval rank to grind. Alliance ships are not rank-locked; build Alliance and minor-faction reputation only when a permit, engineer or mission relationship requires it.
details: The Alliance Defence Force has no auxiliary rank system equivalent to the Federal or Imperial Navy Auxiliary.
Alliance Chieftain, Challenger, Crusader and other Alliance-associated ships do not require an Alliance rank.
Alioth is permit-locked, but its permit comes through the Alioth Independents minor faction rather than an Alliance navy rank.
Bill Turner is a major reason to care about Alliance/Alioth reputation because his base is in permit-locked Alioth.

entries.topic: Pilots' Federation Career Ranks & Elite V
entries.ruleOfThumb: Elite tracks six independent careers: Combat, Trade, Exploration, Mercenary, Exobiology and CQC. Each reaches Elite and can continue through Elite I, II, III, IV and V.
details: The six career tracks use different named ranks below Elite, but all share the Elite → Elite I → Elite II → Elite III → Elite IV → Elite V prestige progression.
Career ranks progress from doing the corresponding activity; they are independent of Federation/Empire Navy rank.
Engineer access can depend on specific career ranks—for example Lori Jameson requires Combat rank Dangerous or higher.
CQC has its own career track, but the Founders World permit is granted by Elite in Combat, Trade, Exploration, Mercenary or Exobiology rather than CQC.

sources.name: E:D Black Box — Pilots Federation ranks

entries.ruleOfThumb: Reach Elite in Combat, Trade, Exploration, Mercenary or Exobiology to earn access to Shinrarta Dezhra and Jameson Memorial.
details: Shinrarta Dezhra is the Pilots Federation headquarters system and is permit-locked.
Jameson Memorial stocks all normal ships and modules in one place and applies a 10% discount.
Lori Jameson is located in Shinrarta Dezhra, so her Engineer path also requires Founders World access in addition to her own meeting/unlock requirements.
CQC progression has its own rewards but is not listed among the career Elite paths granting the Founders World permit.

entries.ruleOfThumb: Check the specific permit source before grinding. Permits can be tied to Navy rank, Pilots' Federation rank, or reputation with a permit-holder faction followed by a permit/invitation mission.
details: Federal and Imperial career milestones automatically unlock several rank-gated systems such as Sol and Achenar.
Shinrarta Dezhra is tied to qualifying Pilots' Federation Elite rank.
Faction-distributed permits commonly require high reputation with the permit-holder and then a permit-acquisition/invitation mission from that faction in a system where it is present.
Not every permit-locked system is necessarily obtainable through ordinary gameplay, so verify the current source before grinding reputation.

entries.ruleOfThumb: For Bill Turner, become Friendly with the Alliance and Allied with the Alioth Independents, obtain the Alioth permit, then complete Turner's own unlock requirement.
details: Alioth is permit-locked and does not use an Alliance Navy rank because no such rank exists.
INARA currently lists Friendly with the Alliance plus Allied with the Alioth Independents as Turner's meeting path for Alioth access.
Bill Turner then separately requires 50 units of Bromellite for his Engineer unlock.
Treat the system permit and the Engineer unlock as two distinct gates.

entries.ruleOfThumb: Marco Qwent sits behind two gates: access to permit-locked Sirius through Sirius Corporation and then Qwent's own Engineer unlock requirements.
details: Sirius is currently permit-locked and controlled by Sirius Corporation.
INARA lists Qwent's meeting requirement as gaining an invitation from Sirius Corporation.
After access, Qwent separately requires 25 Modular Terminals to unlock.
Do not confuse the Sirius system permit/invitation with Qwent's material unlock payment.

entries.topic: Engineers Behind Rank or Permit Gates
entries.ruleOfThumb: When an Engineer seems unlocked but unreachable, check the system permit separately. Several Engineers have both personal meeting requirements and a permit-locked home system.

Friendly Alliance + Allied Alioth Independents; then 50 Bromellite
Combat rank Dangerous or higher; then 25 Kongga Ale
Friendly with the Empire; then 50 Decoded Emission Data

entries.ruleOfThumb: Decide the exact unlock first, then grind only the progression system that gates it: REP rewards for Federal/Imperial Navy progression, minor-faction rep for faction permits, or the relevant career activity for Pilots' Federation ranks.
details: For a Corvette, stop at Federal Rear Admiral; higher Federal ranks add no ship unlock.
For a Cutter, stop at Imperial Duke unless a higher title is desired for its own sake.
For Sol or Achenar, target the required Navy rank rather than grinding unrelated local influence.
For Alioth or Sirius, work the named permit-holder faction rather than a generic superpower grind.
For Shinrarta Dezhra, pursue one qualifying career track to Elite rather than Navy rank.
